outcomes.name: The approach to managing resistance has been refined based on pilot learnings
The approach to managing resistance is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on People Experience & Culture to identify what needs to change in the approach to managing resistance before scaling.
Refine the approach to managing resistance to People Experience & Culture based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined approach to managing resistance covering People Experience & Culture ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined approach to managing resistance for People Experience & Culture is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the approach to managing resistance for People Experience & Culture remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the approach to managing resistance affected Skills & Behaviour.
Adapt the approach to managing resistance relating to Skills & Behaviour for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the approach to managing resistance covering Skills & Behaviour to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Skills & Behaviour among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the approach to managing resistance for Skills & Behaviour.
